title: Runner source manifest version 1
description: Content-only manifest. Implementations must also enforce the semantic path, ordering, alias, symlink-resolution, UTF-8 byte, aggregate-size and JSON ambiguity constraints documented in protocols/runner/README.md.

target.description: Exact relative target; dot and parent components retain their symlink-resolution meaning. Must resolve inside the workspace without a cycle.

bound.description: Present only as true: the path is ignored by Git in the source worktree and was captured because a planned task declares it as an input. Part of the canonical bytes, so binding a path changes the source digest; an explicit false is rejected as non-canonical.

path.description: Canonical slash-separated relative path, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, 64 components and 255 bytes per component; no Git metadata, reserved portable names, trailing dot/space or Unicode control/replacement characters.
